text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Here is the growth rate, computed at twenty-four settings. Below about nine, every field fades. Then growth turns positive: the dynamo is on. Near seventeen and a half, it switches off again. Above about twenty-seven, it comes back. Not one threshold, but windows: turning a knob further does not always help. It agrees with published results. No machine learning yet: this only tests the solver.
